purpose: Define the derived projection from validated MCP advertisements/bindings into the AIGMos Tool surface, preserving origin, local identity, schema and permission boundaries.

topics.name: MCP to Tool Projection
topics.purpose: Define the derived projection from validated MCP advertisements/bindings into the AIGMos Tool surface, preserving origin, local identity, schema and permission boundaries.

semantics.projection_rule: MCP -> Tool is a derived registration/projection from a validated binding.
semantics.origin_rule: Projected tool retains MCP server/tool origin provenance.
semantics.identity_rule: Projected local tool identity is explicit and stable for the lifetime of its binding.
semantics.availability_rule: Remote availability affects runtime availability state, not local semantic identity.
semantics.schema_rule: Projected tool exposes only the validated local schema/effect surface.
semantics.removal_rule: If binding/server is removed, projected runtime availability is removed without rewriting unrelated tool identities.
semantics.model_rule: Model may see/use only tools that are both projected/available and permitted by current invocation policy.

invariants.rule: MCP server identity, transport, tool schema, lifecycle and authority remain explicit and do not inherit trust from connectivity or advertised metadata.

hard_gates.condition: server availability becomes local semantic identity
projected tool exposes unvalidated remote fields/effects
removing MCP server deletes unrelated local tool identities
model sees/invokes tool solely because remote server advertises it

prose.summary: Define the derived projection from validated MCP advertisements/bindings into the AIGMos Tool surface, preserving origin, local identity, schema and permission boundaries.
